Name: Hector Salamanca (George Replacer)
Author: OffPlace
Description:
[i]The default version of this mod changes both [b]sprites/portraits[/b] and [b]dialogue[/b]. Not only will Hector now only communicate with his bell, but all references to George and the Mullner family have been altered to reflect Hector and the Salamanca family name. (This means other character's should no longer reference George or the Mullner name.)[/i]
[b]
!!!DIALOGUE OPTION ONLY SUPPORTS ENGLISH, SORRY TO MY FOREIGN GAMERS!!!


[i]This mod changes[/i][/b][b][i]:[/i][/b]
[b]Sprites/Portraits:
[/b][list]
[*]Changes George Mullner's normal and winter sprites to Hector Salamanca sprites
[*]Changes George Mullner's normal and winter portraits to Hector Salamanca portraits
[/list]
[b]Dialogue (optional):
[/b][list]
[*]Changes all of George's old dialogue to be dings from his bell [i](Ding!)[/i]
[*]Changes all references of George's name to Hector [i](changes other character's dialogue as well as notes, quests, etc.)[/i]
[*]Changes all references of the Mullner family name to the Salamanca family name [i](changes other character's dialogue as well as notes, quests, etc.)[/i]
[/list]
[b][i]1.0.1 changes:
[/i][/b][list]
[*]Fixed the optional version of the mod (which leaves dialogue unchanged) to actually work... I think
[/list]

The default version of this mod changes both the sprites/portraits as well as all relevant dialogue. There is a separate download of this mod that only changes his sprites/portraits if you want to be able to understand what he's saying. I'm sure I've missed some dialogues and probably have messed up the winter versions of the character, so if you happen to find any inconsistencies or bugs, please let me know!

~ OffPlace
